editing a criterion while dropping the /ACnn suffix from its @covers tag is binding_removed, and the SAME input exits 0 under head-manifest-only resolution (AC-K14 / Probe C)

the greenness walk RAISES on an empty link set and no evaluate_keystone path can reach it (AC-K16)
an unminted changed criterion and a new FR stating no criterion each block, with reader-divergence taking precedence over the new-FR arm for the same FR (AC-K2/AC-K3/AC-K9d)

a docs-only commit exits 0 with an empty change set (AC-K1)

base resolution goes through _merge_base's own verdict, so a master-default repo exits on the merits and an unresolvable base exits 2 naming a remedy that applies (AC-K11)

the ci.yml step wiring - pull_request-only, no continue-on-error, same job as AND after the regeneration step, no conditional dependency on another step, and the regeneration step overwrites the very file the gate reads (AC-K12)
